title: feat: redesign models catalog UI
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Redesigns desktop and mobile model cards with stable identity, metadata, access, and pricing layouts.
- Normalizes cache, request, and unit pricing labels with aligned values and responsive positioning.
- Adds touch-friendly shared tooltips, explicit mobile disclosure controls, and accessible copy interactions.
- Adds semantic New and Free chip intents and community model-type icons.
- Clarifies agent base-model and Pollinations tools pricing guidance.

## Validation

- `npx tsc --noEmit` in `enter.pollinations.ai`
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` in `packages/ui`
- Browser verification across official/community, desktop/mobile, tooltip, copy, and disclosure states
- Staging: https://staging.enter.pollinations.ai/models

gist.headline: The model garden got labels
gist.blurb: The models catalog got a careful repotting: clearer cards, tidier prices, and fewer tiny details escaping into the mulch. It now works properly with thumbs, tooltips, and the ancient human ritual of copying text.
gist.summary: Redesigned the enter.pollinations.ai models catalog across desktop and mobile with stable model metadata, aligned cache/request/unit pricing, New and Free chips, community model-type icons, touch-friendly tooltips, copy controls, and mobile disclosure actions.
gist.impact: Developers can compare official and community models, understand access and pricing guidance, reveal details on mobile, and copy model information with a clearer and more accessible catalog layout.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model catalog greenhouse: neatly labeled code-plants represent different AI models, with clear price tags, Free and New seed packets, and small community flower icons. Polli acts as the observant garden keeper, using a tiny magnifying glass to inspect tidy labels while a friendly CRT monitor robot presents an easy-to-read catalog card; a large touch-friendly sign and a copyable note symbolize mobile disclosure, tooltips, and copy interactions.
